name: tr-business-uniform-chart-of-accounts
title: Uniform chart of accounts of Türkiye (Tekdüzen Hesap Planı)
description: The Tekdüzen Hesap Planı (uniform chart of accounts) for private-sector enterprises under 1 Sıra No'lu Muhasebe Sistemi Uygulama Genel Tebliği (MSUGT): 9 account classes, 58 groups and 285 ledger accounts, including amendments reflected in the GİB consolidated text (financial leasing and inflation-adjustment accounts).

sources.title: 1 Sıra No'lu Muhasebe Sistemi Uygulama Genel Tebliği, Resmî Gazete 26.12.1992 / 21447 (Mükerrer), section B – Hesap Planı as published in the GİB consolidated PDF (muhsisteb1ekmuh5), including later MSUGT amendments present in that text (e.g. 11 and 12 Sıra No'lu tebliğler: finansal kiralama and enflasyon düzeltmesi accounts), retrieved 2026-11-16

fields.name: code
fields.description: Account code as in the plan: 1 digit for a class, 2 for a group, 3 for a ledger account. Keep as a string; do not strip leading zeros if a future extension adds them.

fields.name: parent_code
fields.description: Code of the parent row (class for a group, group for an account). Empty for classes.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Hierarchy level: class (hesap sınıfı), group (hesap grubu) or account (defteri kebir hesabı).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Turkish name from section B of the tebliğ (uppercase). Contra accounts keep the trailing (-) as published.

fields.name: is_contra
fields.description: true when the published name ends with (-), i.e. a contra (düzenleyici) account.

fields.name: cost_option
fields.description: For class 7 only: A for the 7/A option (groups 70–78 and their accounts), B for the 7/B option (group 79 and its accounts). Empty for all other rows.
